'''Mustang Express Pipeline''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref name="r154140">{{Cite web|url=https://www.armenergy.com/news/arm-energy-and-pimco-annouce-2-3-billion-investment-in-mustang-express-pipeline/|title=ARM Energy and PIMCO Announce $2.3 Billion Investment in Mustang Express Pipeline|website=armenergy.com|access-date=2026-11-05}}</ref>

==Location==
Cougar Lateral: The pipeline is proposed to run from Tres Palacios Storage, Texas to Katy Hub, Texas.<ref name="r568b1b">{{Cite web|url=https://www.chron.com/gulf-coast/article/texas-pipeline-houston-katy-21099020.php|title=Texas energy companies approve $2.3-billion gas pipeline|website=chron.com|access-date=2026-11-05}}</ref><ref name="r30800f">{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=Natural Gas Pipeline Projects, U.S. Energy Information Administration, August 2026|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-05}}</ref>
Golden Triangle/Spindletop Storage Lateral: The pipeline is proposed to run from Spindletop, Texas to Golden Triangle, Texas.<ref name="r568b1b" /><ref name="r154140" />

==Background==
===Mainline===
The Mustang Mainline is the 178-mile segment of the Mustang Express Pipeline. It runs from the Katy Hub in Katy, Texas to Port Arthur, Texas.<ref name="r154140" /><ref name="r568b1b" /> ARM Energy Holdings announced a final investment decision on the 42-inch Mustang Express Pipeline on October 9, 2025. The $2.3 billion project had an anchor shipper commitment from Sempra Infrastructure for its Port Arthur LNG Phase 2 project. ARM Energy was to build and operate it with Pacific Investment Management Company and co-investors. The pipelines have a total capacity of 2.5 billion cubic feet per day and were expected to be finished in late 2028 or early 2029.<ref name="r154140" />

===Cougar Lateral===
The Cougar Lateral is a 55-mile segment of the Mustang Express Pipeline. It runs from the Tres Palacios Storage to the Katy Hub in Katy, Texas.<ref name="r154140" /> A Houston Chronicle article from October 2025 placed Tres Palacios Storage in Bay City.<ref name="r568b1b" />

===Golden Triangle/Spindletop Storage Lateral===
The Golden Triangle and Spindletop Storage Lateral is a three-mile segment of the Mustang Express Pipeline around Port Arthur, Texas.<ref name="r154140" />
